extension.description: Preview and visually edit MkDocs Material documentation right inside VS Code
config.language: Language of the extension interface. `auto` follows the display language of VS Code.
config.language.enum.0: Follow the display language of VS Code
config.showSiteHeader: Show the site header (name, logo, tabs, repository link) in the preview and in the visual editor. Toggled by the “Header” button on the toolbar.
config.showSiteNav: Show the list of site pages on the left (`nav` from `mkdocs.yml`, or the files in `docs/` when it is absent). Toggled by the “Navigation” button on the toolbar.
config.showToc: Show the “On this page” table of contents on the right in the preview. Toggled by the “Contents” button on the toolbar.
config.pageBackground: Page background in the preview and the visual editor. `material` — the colour of the Material scheme, as on the published site; `editor` — the background and the code colour of the VS Code theme, so the page blends into the editor.
config.pageBackground.enum.0: As in Material (like the published site)
config.pageBackground.enum.1: As in the VS Code theme
config.palette.enum.unset: As in mkdocs.yml (or the Material default)
config.palette.light.primary: Primary colour of the light scheme in the preview and the visual editor. `theme.palette` in mkdocs.yml wins: the setting only applies where the project says nothing.
config.palette.light.accent: Accent colour of the light scheme (links, active elements). `theme.palette` in mkdocs.yml wins.
config.palette.dark.primary: Primary colour of the dark scheme (`slate`). The `slate` entry of `theme.palette` in mkdocs.yml wins; with no such entry the light scheme's colour is used.
config.palette.dark.accent: Accent colour of the dark scheme (`slate`). The `slate` entry of `theme.palette` in mkdocs.yml wins.
config.followActiveEditor: Preview follows the active Markdown editor.
config.scrollSync: Synchronize scrolling between the editor and the preview (built-in renderer only).
config.imagePasteFolder: Folder for images pasted or dropped into the visual editor (relative to the current file). A relative link `![](assets/…)` is inserted into the document.
config.inlineFormatting: Where to show inline text formatting (bold, italic, strikethrough, code, highlight, link) in the visual editor.
config.inlineFormatting.enum.0: Only the popup menu on selected text (buttons are removed from the toolbar)
config.inlineFormatting.enum.1: Both on the toolbar and in the popup menu on selection
config.toolbarButtons: Components from the “Insert” menu pinned as quick buttons on the visual editor toolbar. Configured with the gear button in the editor.
config.keybindings: Keyboard shortcut overrides for the visual editor: command id (`format.bold`, `insert.table`, `style.h2`…) → a combination such as `mod+shift+alt+t`, where `mod` is `Cmd` on macOS and `Ctrl` elsewhere. An empty string disables the shortcut. Only differences from the defaults are stored; configured in the editor: gear → “Keyboard shortcuts”.
capabilities.untrustedWorkspaces: The extension reads the project configuration (mkdocs.yml), includes files the pages ask for (--8<--) and applies the project stylesheets (extra_css) — all of it from the folder you opened.
capabilities.virtualWorkspaces: The extension works with the files of the project on disk: page paths, includes and the addresses inside extra_css are resolved as file paths.
